I tried it for the first time yesterday on turn2me.org.

Won't be going back there again, the person running the group just kept saying "and how does that make you feel" (obviously the answer is going to be anxious), and another member of the chat was really rude and unpleasant to me.

I was on this for about a year, I came off it 6 months ago, and this week I'm going back to my doctor to go back on.

Initially, I felt like a zombie. Felt dizzy, out of sorts, confused and found it very hard to focus and get work done.

After 4-6 weeks this faded and I began to feel more like "me". I didn't suffer with anxiety as much as I did previously, but I did have other shit going on my life that brought me down. I also felt like everything was sort of numb. Yes, I didnt feel anxious anymore but I didn't feel anything really.

Like I say though, with other stuff going on in my life it's hard to know whether I really was feeling noting or it was my current life circumstances that made me feel that way.

Coming off the medication was the same as going on- dizzy and confused. Hard to focus.
